items.title: Why Micron Stock Is Falling Today
items.summary: Micron is falling after Democrats swept the midterms and won the governor's races in Texas and Ohio, raising doubts about how fast new data centers get built.

items.title: Micron Sinks 6% as Democratic Sweep Stokes Fears of an AI “Slowdown in Build”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron shares fell 6% today as Democrats won control of Congress. Investors priced in a slower AI build-out, which Jim Cramer said would let memory inventories build up, a win for Apple.

items.title: Micron Stock Faces a Memory Price Conundrum in the Wake of Democrat Success
items.summary: Micron stock falls as investors digest the Democratic wave and signs rising memory prices are hitting some areas of the hardware market.

items.title: Cramer’s Blue Wave Call: “Apple Winner” as Slower Data Center Builds Ease the Memory Squeeze
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApple guided its December-quarter gross margin to 45%-46% this week because memory costs are rising, and those same prices have sent Micron’s sales soaring. Jim Cramer called Apple a winner from the Democratic midterm sweep, because slower data center construction could let DRAM inventories build up.

items.title: Apple’s Pain Could Be Micron’s Gain as Memory Prices Surge
items.summary: Memory prices are climbing fast, and that single cost is splitting two tech giants onto opposite sides of a trade. One company's suffering feeds the other's record margins, and the gap between them keeps widening.
